concepts.name: Joint inquiry into solutions
concepts.summary: The stage shift in the conversation is from understanding and expression into design. The core move is to propose joint inquiry into solutions rather than a solution. The lead is on process, not on unilateral control of the outcome.
forbiddenZones: Do not turn this into generic decision-making advice
Do not present taking the lead as taking over
Do not let problem-solving replace listening or expression

callbackConnections.connection: Problem-solving becomes real only after each side has actually been heard.
Problem-solving follows clean expression rather than substituting for it.

concepts.name: Two failure modes
concepts.summary: At the problem-solving stage, conversations usually fail through drift or unilateral prescription. Drift produces relief without change. Unilateral prescription produces surface agreement and quiet undermining because the other person did not help design the plan.
forbiddenZones: Do not describe drift as harmless
Do not describe unilateral control as efficient collaboration

concepts.name: Invent options and use mutual standards
concepts.summary: The first option on the table should not become the trench. Generate several options before evaluating any one, then compare them against mutual standards rather than raw preference. Mutual standards move the discussion from 'your way vs. my way' toward criteria both people would accept in advance.
forbiddenZones: Do not turn option generation into endless brainstorming
Do not treat mutual standards as simple compromise

concepts.name: Build on proposals and agree on specifics
concepts.summary: A proposal from the other side is material to improve, not a target to destroy. The conversation becomes action only when the agreed next steps are specific, observable, and assigned. Specificity is the bridge between insight and behavior.
forbiddenZones: Do not collapse this into project-management jargon
Do not confuse specificity with bureaucratic detail for its own sake

concepts.name: Specific commitments must track real agency
concepts.summary: Specific next steps fail when they require promises broader than the person's actual control. Across power gaps or constrained systems, good process language can still become coercive if one party is pushed into false commitments for the sake of closure.
forbiddenZones: Do not treat specificity as always virtuous
Do not ignore power and agency differences in the hard case

callbackConnections.connection: Problem-solving still depends on having the right purpose. Some conversations should not be forced into design.

schoolSettings: Graduate teaching logistics under faculty power gap (Mira/Professor Rowan)
